avis.texte: The honey like texture had me at hello. Unfortunately, i had an adverse reaction to the product and broke out with a horrible rash

I was given a sample & while doing my nightly Skincare, I am happy to say just how soothing & Moisturized my skin feels! I do have Combo skin & if used like instructed I noticed that It wasn't greasy nor heavy! Definitely will continue to use.

I'm 53, pre-menopausal skin, aka dry, sensitive, ugh, and this has saved my skin! I've literally tried everything! I use rentin-a and I just can't describe the feeling of waking up th fist morning I used this and my skin felt soooo good! Amazing!!!!

I like the concept and it melts into your skin but this sunscreen is super greasy and never settles into skin. It looks like you've smeared literal oil all over you and feels greasy to the touch and comes off on everything you touch. Imposible to use on your face unless you just want to look like a greaseball. Doesn't work with makeup. That kind of shine can look nice on the body, but I found this just smears on everything you touch no matter how long you have it on.

avis.titre: One of the best skincare products out!!
avis.texte: I received this in my Body Charm a few years ago. I loved it, straight away. During the cold months, my t-zone gets very dry. This keeps my t-zone from drying out and my face and hands from getting tight in the winter. I also adore the smell!! The smell of fresh tulips brings to mind spring and really helps if you suffer from seasonal depression. I use this liberally.....not every day, because there are some days where it's just a little too emollient for my needs. You don't need much,AT ALL. The cute little tool you get to dispense it? I just dip it in and let it get coated. That's enough for my face and the back of my hands. My jar isn't even down by half and I have used it at least 4x a week for about 4 years!! This is an excellent product that really LASTS!! I bought 2 back ups in the Boxy Charm store and at this rate, I can't see ever running out if it!! Whenever you can catch this in stock, GRAB A JAR. They haven't raised the price as far as I've noticed, since I first discovered this company. Even if I had paid full price, it would have been well worth it!! Going by the number of items in the box & the price of my subscription at that time, my jar only ran me around $6USD. About $1.50 a year so far, for one of the best skin products I've ever used. This also does well removing eye makeup and moisturizing lips. Excellent formula, don't change a thing!!🩷🌷🩷🌷🩷🌷🩷🌷🩷🌷
I use this with my tret at night and I LOVE it. Super hydrating. My face looks amazing after and helps my skin be less irritated from the tret.

This is a very nourishing mask and a little truly goes a long way! It took care of the irritation on my neck after a few days. The only downside is getting used to the slight smell and not using too much because then it can feel heavy. Will buy again!
I love this product. Texture is lovely, moisture it provides is wonderful. My skin looks refreshed and glowy. Highly recommend!
Loving the Royal Tulip Moisturizing Nectar. I slather it on before bed and my skin is dewy and plump in the AM
The nectar was the first product I tried with BloomEffects. It was love at first try. I haven't look back.

avis.titre: This is the most hydrating moisturizing skin care.
avis.texte: I love the original packaging. But I love the results of this moistening skin care. I REALLY can't live without. I am of mature skin and this is part of my routine skin care.

The Royal Tulip Moisturizing Nectar feels sticky and does not absorb well into my skin. I have used it for a couple of weeks as the last step in my evening routine, but I am not sure if the long-term benefits are worth the uncomfortable texture.

avis.titre: Relief for burns and dry cracked skin
avis.texte: I had passed this new Bloomeffects section in the store today and tried out th Nectar on my atrocious crusty red oven rack burn on my wrist. Insane- so moisturizing and did not dry out after a few minutes, stays damp/moist and dewy. After 10 mins my pink and red burn was reduced by at least 70% to the point where it's almost gone. I am so shocked. Will be buying now for my dry winter skin 😳😳😳

This moisturizer works wonderfully and lasts all day long on my dry, sensitive, mature skin. It also works beautifully under spf. My only criticism is that the small is slightly off-putting. This is common in natural skincare somewhere I am used to this but it would be nice to add a bergamot or something to give it a more pleasant but natural scent. However, this is highly effective and an excellent moisturizer.

Before even reviewing the effectiveness of this product, I would like to highlight how luxurious the packaging and metal applicator is. The product itself has a honey texture that I was able to apply and sleep with on my face over night. I woke up glowy and plump!! My dry patches from the winter are smoothed over and I can finally apply face makeup again. I will be using this product at least twice a week

I received this in my Boxycharm years ago and I still have some left because it is such a potent treatment that all you need is a tiny bit. It has become my favorite nighttime treatment for the colder months, as it is also perfect for me to mix my Tretinoin with it! 100% recommend!!
This is my favorite moisturizing nectar so far, it leaves my skin hydrated even in the morning after a night application my skin feels hydrated, and my skin is radiant

I absolutely LOVE this moisturizer/serum. It is my favorite thing to use as the last step of my skin care routine and a little bit goes a long way. I love the glass bottle and the scooper that it came with. I even bought another bottle as a gift for my mom ❤️❤️❤️
Just a dab at bedtime - - a little goes a long way and feels wonderful.

I have used this product every single day since I bought it! It is perfect for my dry skin since I get SO much drier in the winter. I use it over my moisturizer at night, then spot-treat my dry areas in the morning under makeup. I really like the gel-to-oil texture, not too heavy at all. No real fragrance to speak of and a little goes a long way. The jar is beautiful too!
This is the third time I have purchased this moisturizer. It works wonders on dry winter skin—highly recommended.
This cream is highly appreciated for its rich yet light texture, which effectively penetrates the skin.
10/10 for slugging, as a moisturizing mask, or spot treatment on my sensitive, acne prone skin. Best of all, a little goes a long way. Will be repurchasing

I absolutely love this product!! I like to skin flood and I also use tretinoin which can leave me dry at times. Now I use this as my last step and it's locking all my hydration and moisture in and I wake up with smooth soft skin! Can't wait to try more of their products.
Love the rich smooth cream and how it glides on the skin. Use very little for deep hydration and I have very dry skin.

avis.titre: Had to use it to believe it!
avis.texte: This is a miracle worker for my reactive Skin, I have been using it as the last step in my night time routine and I wake up with soft bouncy and calm skin. Would keep repurchasing forever!

Since summer lingers still, I find this nectar too heavy for the climate where I live. However, this feature could be an advantage as the weather cools. So, providing a fair review is not possible at this time. I might add that I use daily Bloomeffects serums, moisturizer, and face scrub. Love them all, which is why I ordered the royal tulip nectar.

This moisturizer/occlusive/micro-slugging product is insanely good. There is another product on the market with 30% Glycerin that went viral and still is a favorite of so many on the socials. I never liked it-it was sticky. This one is not in the slightest. It's luxurious and melts into your skin-not sticky at all. It feels heavenly and it is one of those products you can't wait to use again. Finally-just wait till the morning glow. Not a greasy glow but more of a plumped up glow from within. Absolutely phenomenal and I'm so happy I tried it. Definitely will repurchase again and again.
This is the first product I tried from Bloomeffects and I am obsessed! I have very dry skin and this nectar is a miracle worker for me.
I have very dry skin and this is an absolute godsend for me!! I put it on as my last step before bed and wake up to moisturized skin.
Where has the stuff been my whole life? Lol seriously a must for dry skin. I love it and can't wait to try more products.
Such a unique product that is safe for literally any skin type!
This nectar feels wonderful on the skin. It's very creamy and hydrating without being greasy or sticky. I love this stuff!

After searching for months and investing in many products I've found "the one" that lives up to its claims. Slug with a little bit of this product every night and I'm finally not dry and tight in the AM! Well worth the $$$!
This has helped my dry aging skin so much. I love the texture and I love how it soaks into my skin. Thank you for making a product that works.
I have such dry skin in the winter. If I out this in before bed, I wake up with soft skin. It's great.

I am 43 with very reactive, dry skin and live in a dry and cold climate. I use this in the morning before my sunscreen and it helps keep moisture in my skin despite the heater running at work. I also use it at night and feel like it's way better than Vaseline as a final step. My face used to feel tight around lunch time but because of this moisturizer I don't even think about it. I still use my regular moisturizer with this as a final step and I'm on my second bottle and highly recommend it if your skin is very dry. Also once it's soaked in, my skin is SO soft unlike some moisturizers where once it's soaked in it feels like it was never there and they sometimes make my skin feel worse once it's dried down. I hope this never gets discontinued because I don't know what I'd do without it.

This gem has been on my list for some time. Not sure why I waited so long. It's lovely! The texture starts like honey but then melts like many other serums. My skin sucks it up and I really do feel like it makes it glow a little bit more in the morning. I would absolutely recommend to anyone.
The nectar is a game changer. My skin is so smooth and glowing! Im amazed at the difference in just a couple weeks. No more flakey irritated skin

I broke out with a couple spots of eczema a while ago. I've never had it before and wasn't sure what to dofor it. The spots were flaky and dry to the point that the skin cracked. To make matters worse it was on my face. My daughter suggested I try her Royal Tulip Moisturizing Nectar on it, and it immediately improved. So much so in fact, that I ordered my own. It's basically gone now and without the cortisone cream recommended by the doctor. My daughter and I both have super sensitive skin and most products will cause us to have a rosacea breakout. Not this! It's gentle and very hydrating. Love it!
Received a sample of this product and immediately purchased the full-size version. My skin loves this product. So dewy and moisturizing. Love for a no make-up day with a cream blush on top.

avis.titre: Please don't ever stop making this
avis.texte: The only product I've ever found that seriously helps my chronically dry skin, I've tried every heavy cream and oil. Amazing and unique!

I've always had great skin but around 39 it started to get flaky, especially with make up on. I tried everything and then I finally came across this product. During summer I use a light layer under make up, the rest of the year I put it on in the evening in a bit of a thicker layer. It has given me the smoothness and plumpness I had lost.
I can't believe how moist my skin still is in the morning. It is an unbelievable formulation.

This was exactly what my skin needed during this dry winter season. I also started using the cleansing jelly and the cleansing cream then finish with this in the evening. My skin has totally transformed. It's clean but still hydrated. I don't like the at the nectar feels in the day/under makeup but it's the perfect moisturizer for bedtime.

avis.titre: Exactly what I have been looking for!
avis.texte: It is so hard for me to find a product that wonderfully hydrates and moisturizes without causing some kind of congestion on my skin. THIS product has been absolutely wonderful for my nearly 50 year old skin that is still very sensitive to any kind of poor clogging ingredients. I have only been using for one week so far, but I have also noticed some redness reduction and soothing properties that seem to reduce swelling on any irritated areas. I have fallen 100% for this product, please don't ever stop making it!

I have been using this product for a few years now, even have my husband using it! This product gives us a glowing appearance, like we have been kissed by the sun. The rich moisture it provides and smoothness to the skin is remarkable. Love this product!
I needed extra hydration and nurturing for my neck and this was just the thing! I'm happy I found it.

I bought this as my skin has been sensitive lately due to overuse of actives. I used it for a week in a row and my skin has completely calm down. A little goes a long way too. Will definitely repurchase.

I have been using the product now for about 2 months and my skin feels so moisturized every night that I apply it to my face. I would highly recommend this product especially for those with dry or aging skin.
I use it every night especially in the winter to keep my skin supple and hydrated.

I use this at night before bedtime and wake up with hydrated skin…it truly makes my skin feel better now that winter is here with cold dry air outside and dry air inside from heating. I highly recommend this product.. will definitely repurchase.

I am not exaggerating when I say this product completely changed my extremely dry, acne and clogged pore prone skin. I use it morning and night combined with argan oil and my skin has never been better! It also plays well with my sunscreen. I will never go without it!!!!

This product is extraordinary. I used it every day before going hiking in the arctic in wintertime (so perhaps the most extreme cold and wind effects possible) and it kept my skin perfectly protected from the elements. I can't recommend this product highly enough.
Cannot say enough about this product ! Will Use as a mask and as a moisturizer at night - calms my skin and leaves me so hydrated .
Love this Moisturizing Nectar...I put it on before I go outside in the winter and it has been helping my skin with the cold and wind.

I have been using this for over a year and am so happy with the moisturizing I get with it. It is definitely a thicker product, and a little goes a long way. After I apply it, it drinks into my skin and leaves my skin very soft. I know no claims can be made, but it helps a tiny little dry spot on my chin every time I apply it. I have sensitive skin and it loves this nectar. I try to use "good for you" products and this is definitely one of those.
It is one of my most favourite products that I've ever used. I love the way my skin makes me feel.' Definitely re purchase again

I just started using on my dry, irritated skin. I noticed an immediate difference in inflammation. I'm prone to acne and closed comedones. So far, my skin is really loving this product. It has a lovely texture. Thank you to Mira Aguire for the recommendation. She was spot on!
This saves my skin every fall/winter. I buy this for everyone in my family now and they love it! Feels like butter to put on and stays on my face all night!
Absolutely in love with this product. It is so incredibly hydrating, luxurious and leaves my skin dewy and plump.
I am now obsessed with this!! It's the best skin hydration you can get! I can't get enough!!
I have dry skin so I use this year round. I love how when I apply this in the evening my skin is still moisturized in the morning!
Very nice product and it feels good on my face. I hope it will help with my eczema .
i wear this to bed at night and wake up with dewey, perfected rested skin in the morning!

I have very sensitive skin. I have difficulty finding a product that will do deep moisturizing without breaking me out. This product makes my skin soft and even cleared up my eczema on my face. And even though it's expensive, it last a long time. All you need is the tiniest amount. At first I was skeptical when I read other reviewers say that, but this product is so concentrated, you only need a small amount.

avis.titre: So moisturizing - great for really dry weather.
avis.texte: I love how it feels so thick yet light on my skin. I use it on my face and cuticles. It will be great as the weather gets colder and more dry. I love to use it at night before bed. It's like Vaseline's grown up cousin, which also smells better and doesn't stay sticky!

I absolutely love this nectar! I got a sample from Credo, then came here to buy the full size. It made my skin so hydrated and glowy! I have combo skin, but it gets a little dry this time of year. I am 34 and have some wrinkles and fine lines, but this smoothed my entire face. I also used some on my extremely dry elbow. It is the only moisturizer that has ever worked on my elbow! I don't even have to use it every day. Will definitely repurchase.

This stuff is so delightful. I have extremely dry skin, and I can tell the difference when I wake up in the morning after applying this. Also, it is going to last me forever. It is so rich that you only need a little bit each time. This is going to save my skin this winter.

I received a sample from a credo gift w purchase and fell in love with the royal tulip nectar. So much so, I ended up cutting open the mini tube to utilize every last bit. Needless to say I ordered the product and am now trying additional products as well. So excited to try the entire lineup. 🩵

I've been trying a lot of different moisturizer and thick masks for my dry skin but this is by far my favorite. It goes on so smoothly, doesn't have any scent, and I always wake up with nice, plump skin the next day. It's so amazing for my dry skin, especially with the hormonal changes post partum. It doesn't feel greasy, doesn't run into my eyes, so amazing overall. Will definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: Never been this impressed so quickly
avis.texte: I've only been using this a few nights and I am beyond happy w/ this nectar. I was having a rosacea flare but I took a chance and applied this to my angry skin and oh my! By the first morning my skin was happy and calm, soft & hydrated. Why did I wait so long to buy this? I will be trying more of their formulations immediately.

I love this stuff. I am on my third bottle. My daughter just came home from college and used it and fell in love with it too. She was like-my skin looks so dewy I love it! She's been using it daily now.

Love this product so much I use it every night to seal in all my other products. I wake up with hydrated plump glowing skin.! Must have product if your skin is dehydrated, irritated, dry, have fine line and wrinkles. ❤️

An ample amount on lips followed by Vaseline at night has made a significant improvement for my peeling lips. It is, of course, as superb on face as YouTube Skin Obsessed Mary says. This jar will, thankfully, last a while using 3-4 nights a week..
This is the best moisturizer I've ever used! It is so hydrating in a different way than any water or oil based moisturizers and the moisture lasts throughout the day. Can't recommend enough!
I use it as last step of skin care. Give me this amazing glow!
Keeps my face moist all day. When I first put it on my skin it gives a warm sensation. Keeps my face glowing skin beautiful love it.

avis.titre: The ONLY thing that keeps my skin moisturized!
avis.texte: My skin is dry, acne-prone, and sensitive; I have rosacea and I'm currently taking accutane. I have tried almost a hundred different moisturizers and serums, but Royal Tulip Moisturizing Nectar is truly the best at keeping my skin hydrated and moisturized. I have been using this product for ~2 years now (way before I started accutane) and I'll never stop using it. It is expensive but lasts me about 3 months using it twice a daily (yes, I'm THAT dry) so when you break down the cost it's not too bad. I hope BloomEffects never changes the formula or stops producing this amazing product!

I destroyed my skin barrier between too much retinal and a 30% acid exfoliation. Nothing would soothe my face. I read wonderful reviews about the wonderful properties of honey as a humectant and Bloomeffects clients that I gave it a try. Within in days, my skin was feeling bouncy and fresh again, not angry and irritated. I now use every night and wake up moisturized and fresh. A little goes a long way.

There is nothing out there, that I have tried, like this! I use it at night as the last step in my routine to seal in everything and keep my face hydrated. I wake up glowing! And I go to hot yoga and my skin looks amazing afterwards too. Perfect glow! The consistency is a dream, the best way I can describe it is like a whipped vaseline. Not as heavy as Vaseline. It's amazing!
It is amazing. I use it as my last step in my routine. I wake up with softer radiant skin. Love it.

This is so nice! It's somewhat like aquaphor or petroleum but way better. It's not greasy, probably because it's glycerin, and it absorbs and seals nicely. You stir it is and it glides on smooth with the tulip spatula. A little goes a long way. You can put it everywhere really.

I am on my second bottle and absolutely in love with this product. I love how soft and smooth it makes my skin feel as I put it on. I've tried all the rich creams, La Mer, Augustine Bader, Elemis, the list goes on. Nothing compares to this. It has truly upped my skincare game.
This is my favorite skincare product that I own-the hydration is incredible. I absolutely love it!

avis.titre: My skin looks so much younger
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer for nighttime! I wake up with plumped, glass skin! I'm 47 and notice a visible difference after 1 night.
I've only been using for a week, but as someone with drier skin, I love feeling the honey-like layer on my nighttime skin. I have definitely woke up feeling like my skin is nourished.

I have never experienced a formula like this. The consistency is thick, so you only need a little bit to cover your entire face. I typically use it as a mask at night and since then my skin feels softer and detoxified, like I had a mini facial.

I use this at night as the last step in my routine. You don't need a lot to cover your face and the jar has lasted me quite a long time. If I initially scoop more than I need, I rub the remaining onto the backs of my hands and I instantly see my skin drink this up. On my face, it does not seem to saturate but instead, sits on top of my skin. Because I sleep on my back, getting product on my pillowcase isn't an issue. When I wake up, my skin feels so soft and my skin glows!
This nectar is wonderful! It keeps my skin hydrated and well moisturized!!
I love this! A little goes a long way and it makes my skin so soft!!

Living in Minnesota the winters here are so harsh and the air is dry. I never could find a product that could help my dry skin , WOW did I finally find one. This product is amazing. This has helped my skin so much and now my skin is soft and doesn't feel like it is too small for my face.

I recently over exfoliated and my skin barrier was compromised. This was just about the only thing that I can say help heal and bounce back my skin! I love this and will use it year round! You don't need a lot and can use it day or night. It's amazing! Definitely feel a difference after first use!
I love applying this as my last step of the night. It feels like warm butter and honey. I also love the bottle and the applicator it comes with.

Wowwww!! My skin barrier has been saved with this Tulip Nectar! I'm so impressed as it's only been two weeks and I'm already seeing dramatic results. I layer this over my tretinoin and wake up with the smoothest skin!!!! A definite repurchase!

avis.titre: My skin won't accept anything else!
avis.texte: This is probably my favorite skincare purchase ever. I have very porous but dehydrated skin and this is THE ULTIMATE product. If you're even thinking about buying this you should take the leap. A little goes a long way. My skin now glows before I put anything on it. This is also great for right after shaving for guys! Protects that very sensitive fresh skin and reinforces that barrier. I think we need a JUMBO size bottle for those of us who like slugging!
I need to buy more I ran out this is literally the only thing that helps my skin. I only have very little left

I use this at night and wake up with the softest skin. My skin stays hydrated all night, Still glowy the next morning. This has become a staple in my routine. You only need a little, the bottle will last a long time. I don't find it sticky at all.
Simply amazing for face (and I use it for my body too), it's hydrating, non-irritating and instantly gives you the plump you want.

I love this product and recommend it to all people who have extremely dry skin, especially in the winter months. My skin's thirst is quenched as soon as I slather it on, and lasts throughout the entire day. Definitely recommend for people with eczema or dermatitis.
The tulip nectar is amazing. It is great for face, hands and just about anywhere you feel dryness. It is an amazing formula and so hydrating. Absorbs well into the skin - Love it!
This jar of yumminess has transformed my skin. I wake up and it's so soft and supple. Will definitely keep this in my routine!!

I saw a cosmetic chemist on Tik Tok speaking highly of this and I'm so glad I purchased. It is truly a great product. I use it after my Tretinoin at night and wake up totally smooth and moisturized. I use it everyday without fail.

I love this stuff. I have very dry sensitive skin. I use it everyday, most times twice a day even applying over dew cream! Not dew drops, which I want to try as well. My skin is brighter, clearing of hyperpigmentation, firming , softer as well as waking up to hydrated skin. I use a small amount warm up between my fingers and tap in. If I wear it in the morning I wait a few minutes before I apply my makeup. And my powder foundation goes on smoothly. I love these products, it has changed my skin so quickly. I been using them for about 3 -4 weeks now and within two weeks I saw such a change for the better. Don't hesitate buy today your skin will thank you and your lines will go away and tighten up!

Transformed my skin. For whatever reason, I always feel dehydrated (I drink a lot of water but still) and it really shows in my skin. While I wish the problem would be solved from the "inside", this moisturizer is the only product that hydrates my skin to the point where my skin looks great all the time (not only after I put on the moisturizer, which was the problem with everything else I tried).

I wasn't sure what to expect but o am so glad I tried this incredible product. It seems like it'll be greasy but it's actually just silky and luxurious and my dry skin drinks it up. It leaves my face with a healthy glow and I'll be adding to my collection soon of tulip goodies soon!!

I am usually sensitive to vitamin C and hyaluronic acid. This is gentle enough to use daily so far. It feels soothing and has great ingredients! Hydrating and has not irritated my sensitive skin. Love it!

avis.titre: Last step to seal everything in
avis.texte: I use this as the last step every night to lock everything in. You only need a little bit. It does feel greasy on the skin, but in the morning I wake up with glowing skin. The product does separate and you need to mix it together. It's great for the winter months but would be too heavy in the summer. The presentation for the product is beautiful. Glass container with a spatula. It's pricey but I got it for 30 % off during BF. Try it if you have dry skin. You skin will thank you.
So hydrating and beautiful. Doesn't layer under my sunscreen but I use it at night and love it.
I absolutely love this product! I even got my mom hooked on it. It's super moisturizing, but doesn't have a heavy feel on my skin. It's a miracle in a jar!
My new favorite addition to my nighttime skincare routine. Feels great on the skin and I wake up with a glow.
So very moisturizing. Great for slugging at night. Slightly sticky at first, but I will continue to use it because the end results are simply amazing!
I love this product! it is so weird at first but over time you see how it really works! Leaves my skin feeling hydrated.

I watched tiktok reviews and thought I would hate the texture, but it actually is fairly easy to spread around (last step after all my other skincare) and I think it soaks in just fine. I is currently cold and dry where I live, and this has been making such a big difference in not feeling like a dry dusty gremlin. I have applied makeup on top of this (after letting it sink in) and haven't had any issues. I think it has also been making my psoriasis patches much less red!! I'm in LOVE and afraid to run out
